entity.description:
Luthor was made advisor to the Titans Army, a group of superheroes associated with the Titans recruited to prevent the Teen Titans from changing the timeline. They went back in time to kill Blue Beetle, Ravager, and Supergirl during Starro's invasion, but they were overrun by the alien overlord. The Flash was able to defeat Starro, but during this time Wonder Girl got over Superboy, changing the timeline and causing Luthor and the Titans Army to fade away.
